info.title: Polymarket RTDS (ws-live-data)
info.description:
Public, credential-free WebSocket feed of reference crypto prices: Binance spot, Chainlink spot, and Chainlink-computed 30-second and 60-second TWAPs. Polymarket publishes prose documentation for this feed at https://docs.polymarket.com/market-data/realtime-data and https://docs.polymarket.com/market-data/chainlink-twap, but **no AsyncAPI or other machine-readable contract exists for this host** — unlike clob/gamma/data/relay/perps/bridge/combos-rfq, there is nothing upstream to mirror.

This document is instead modelled entirely on frames captured 2026-09-05 from `wss://ws-live-data.polymarket.com`, copied verbatim from `polyoxide-rtds/src/fixtures.rs` into each message's `x-observed-payload`. It records what the server does, not what a vendor promised, and it **must never be diffed against a published document** in `nightly-schema.yml` or anywhere else — there is nothing to diff it against. See `docs/specs/rtds/OBSERVED.md` for the ways the prose documentation that does exist disagrees with the server, and for behaviour the prose documentation says nothing about at all.

x-observed-connection.finding: One connection multiplexes every subscribed topic, tagged by the envelope's `topic` and `type` fields rather than by separate WebSocket paths — a different shape from the one-connection-per-channel CLOB WebSocket in docs/specs/clob/. `update` frames carry an undocumented `connection_id`; `subscribe` (backfill) frames never do. The only non-JSON text frame ever observed is a single empty string sent immediately after connecting, before any subscribe frame is sent by the client.

body.message: leger GetTopics error: rpc error: code = NotFound desc = topic: definitely_not_a_topic and type: update not found, status: rpc error: code = NotFound desc = topic: definitely_not_a_topic and type: update not found, message: topic: definitely_not_a_topic and type: update not found

x-observed-connection.rejected-subscription-note: One unrecognised topic in a subscription array yields zero frames for every topic in that array, and this single error envelope on a disjoint shape from the normal {topic,type,timestamp,payload} envelope. The 401 status is not meaningful — the body describes a not-found.

production.description: Public RTDS server. No authentication. All four crypto price topics are served on this one connection; there is no per-topic path.

crypto_prices.title: Binance Spot Prices
crypto_prices.description: Binance spot prices, multiplexed on the shared RTDS connection and identified by `topic: "crypto_prices"`. Not a separate WebSocket path — see `servers.production.description`.
crypto_prices.x-observed-notes: `full_accuracy_value` on this topic's `update` payload is a plain decimal (e.g. "79697.73000000"), not E18 fixed-point. Every other topic in this document (`crypto_prices_chainlink`, `crypto_prices_twap_thirty`, `crypto_prices_twap_sixty`) uses E18 for the same field name. Captured ~1 second apart reporting the same asset at the same price as `crypto_prices_chainlink`'s update (see that channel's `cryptoPricesChainlinkUpdate` message), which is the evidence the two cannot share a type: "79697.73000000" (plain) vs "79696948174287960000000" (E18).

crypto_prices_chainlink.title: Chainlink Spot Prices
crypto_prices_chainlink.description: Chainlink spot prices, multiplexed on the shared RTDS connection and identified by `topic: "crypto_prices_chainlink"` on `update` frames. Its `subscribe` (backfill) frame is mislabelled — see `x-observed-notes` on the `subscribe` message below.

crypto_prices_twap_thirty.title: Chainlink 30s TWAP
crypto_prices_twap_thirty.description: Chainlink 30-second TWAP, multiplexed on the shared RTDS connection and identified by `topic: "crypto_prices_twap_thirty"`. Both `update` and `subscribe` (backfill) frames on this topic carry the correct `topic` value.

cryptoPricesSubscribe.name: CryptoPricesSubscribe
cryptoPricesSubscribe.title: Binance Spot Backfill
cryptoPricesSubscribe.summary: The one-shot backfill RTDS sends immediately after subscribing to `crypto_prices`. Upstream documents "no snapshot, history, or replay" for TWAP; this topic sends one regardless, ~120 points (~2 minutes at 1s cadence). Truncated to 3 points below; see `polyoxide-rtds/src/fixtures.rs` for the note on the original length.

x-observed-payload.note: Truncated from 120 points to 3 for this document, matching the fixture.
Captured roughly one second after crypto_prices's update, reporting the same asset at the same price, with byte-identical payload keys.

cryptoPricesChainlinkSubscribe.name: CryptoPricesChainlinkSubscribe
cryptoPricesChainlinkSubscribe.title: Chainlink Spot Backfill
cryptoPricesChainlinkSubscribe.summary: The one-shot backfill RTDS sends immediately after subscribing to `crypto_prices_chainlink`, ~55-59 points.

x-observed-payload.note: Truncated from 59 points to 3 for this document, matching the fixture. Captured on a connection subscribed to crypto_prices_chainlink and nothing else.

cryptoPricesChainlinkSubscribe.x-observed-notes: MISLABELLED: this frame's own `topic` field reads "crypto_prices" — the Binance topic — even though it was captured on a connection subscribed only to crypto_prices_chainlink, and this channel's update frames are correctly labelled crypto_prices_chainlink (see cryptoPricesChainlinkUpdate above). Both spot topics' backfills come back under the crypto_prices label; the symbol format ("btc/usd" vs "btcusdt") is the only discriminator. See docs/specs/rtds/OBSERVED.md for the full finding; polyoxide-rtds corrects this in `correct_mislabelled_spot_snapshot`.

cryptoPricesTwapThirtySubscribe.name: CryptoPricesTwapThirtySubscribe
cryptoPricesTwapThirtySubscribe.title: Chainlink 30s TWAP Backfill
cryptoPricesTwapThirtySubscribe.summary: The one-shot backfill RTDS sends immediately after subscribing to crypto_prices_twap_thirty, ~55-59 points. Contradicts upstream's documented "no snapshot, history, or replay" for TWAP. Points here DO carry full_accuracy_value, unlike the two spot snapshots.

x-observed-payload.note: Truncated to 3 points for this document, matching the fixture. This topic's snapshot is labelled correctly, unlike crypto_prices_chainlink's.

Envelope.description: The frame wrapper common to every topic. `connection_id` is present on `update` frames and absent on `subscribe` (backfill) frames — observed on all four topics.

timestamp.description: Unix milliseconds when RTDS sent this frame.

DisplayPoint.description: One backfill point with no exact value — the shape used by the Binance and Chainlink-spot snapshots.

value.description: The venue's lossy float. The only value this point carries.

ExactPoint.description: One backfill point with an exact value — the shape used by the two TWAP snapshots only.

BinanceSpotUpdatePayload.description: Binance spot price payload. `full_accuracy_value` is a **plain decimal** here — the one topic where it is not E18. See `x-observed-notes` on this channel.

symbol.description: e.g. `btcusdt`. Case-insensitive on subscribe despite documented lowercase-only.

value.description: Lossy float. Never use for arithmetic.

BinanceSpotSnapshotPayload.description: Binance spot backfill payload. Points carry no exact value.

ChainlinkSpotUpdatePayload.description: Chainlink spot price payload. `full_accuracy_value` is E18 fixed-point.

value.description: Lossy float. Never use for arithmetic.

ChainlinkSpotSnapshotPayload.description: Chainlink spot backfill payload. Points carry no exact value, like the Binance backfill.

ChainlinkTwapUpdatePayload.description: Chainlink TWAP payload. `full_accuracy_value` is E18 fixed-point; `window_s` names the lookback window.

value.description: Lossy float. Never use for arithmetic.

window_s.description: Lookback window in seconds: 30 or 60 as observed.

ChainlinkTwapSnapshotPayload.description: Chainlink TWAP backfill payload — unlike the two spot topics, points here DO carry an exact value. Upstream documents "no snapshot, history, or replay" for TWAP; the server sends one regardless.
